title: Evidence-Burden Uplift by Recovery Method
content:
# Evidence-burden uplift

> Harborline Customer Accounts

**Clause.** The evidence-burden uplift of the late-review goodwill follows the request's evidence route, the recovery method shown on the recovery request record: government ID adds $5.00, PIN and card adds $2.00, and the email link adds nothing. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the late-review goodwill figure.

**The routes.** Government ID is reviewed by Trust and Safety; PIN and card proves the support PIN together with the last four card digits and billing postal code; the email link goes to the profile contact email.

**Q&A.** *Does the method of an earlier, rejected request count?* No; the route read is that of the approved request the goodwill concerns.
